facts.fact: 章首：深夜收拾行装——试吃硬奶酪、塞肉干坚果与母亲魔法书、尽量多塞药瓶
facts.anchor: Andra sniffed the hardened cheese, sneaking a small bite for approval before wrapping it tight in the scrap of linen.

facts.fact: Bernice 炉边沉睡呼吸渐稳仍费力；叔叔表亲不信她——她不许动摇
facts.anchor: Not while Bernice lay sleeping by her hearth, her breaths strengthening, but still labored.

facts.fact: Gaya 推下黑色小书——从未见过的另一本魔法书
facts.anchor: Above her, Gaya slunk across the top of the shelving, knocking a black leather-bound book at her feet.

facts.fact: 小书内页：匆促咒语+环形暗符号——母亲练过她不知道的魔法
facts.anchor: Incantations. Spells. But Mother didn’t practice this kind of magic, did she?

facts.fact: 留护理字条后吻别 Bernice 指节：“也许爱也能让人做最好的事”
facts.anchor: kissing her knuckles as she whispered, “Maybe love can also make people do the best things.”

facts.fact: 只带一袋补给、一知半解，独自连夜出发
facts.anchor: With nothing more than a satchel of supplies and limited knowledge of life outside her woods, Andra set off into the night.

facts.fact: 夜林异动——指尖火花照向暗处，来者是 Lucas
facts.anchor: she spun toward the noise as sparks blossomed from her fingertips. She held the flames high above her

facts.fact: Lucas 摊牌：你不会留下让别人为你战为你死；质问计划是什么
facts.anchor: “Because you’re my best friend, and I know you.” Lucas approached her.

facts.fact: 捧脸立誓：不赞成也不让你独行；她哭着问“要是我不够格呢”
facts.anchor: “I may not agree with you, but I will not let you do this alone.”

facts.fact: Lucas 演讲：Cecilia 之女、纪念日实为纪念你母亲、同样魔法在你血管
facts.anchor: You are the daughter of Cecilia the Light Witch, the one who conquered darkness a century ago.

facts.fact: 吹哨唤三马：Daegal 与 Tolan 同行；翻身上马回望林子盼再见
facts.anchor: Hooves trotted against the earth, and a lantern bobbed into view as three horses approached them.
